summary: Mineral County, MT tower on the Lolo NF: a 30-ft L-4 cab built 1934, abandoned 1967, and both structures destroyed in a 2000 wildfire.

facts.design: 30-ft round timber tower with L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Tower and cabin both burned in 2000; no source describes what remains on the ridge.

events.note: Site developed with a log cabin and platform tower (firelookout.com)
30-ft tower with L-4 cab replaced an earlier log cabin
Erwin named as lookout on Landowner peak; Lester Ellingson reported back from the post (two Missoulian items dated Sept 1 and Sept 22, via Forest Lookouts)
Carl Creagar left to work as lookout at Landowner peak near Alberton (Ravalli Republican item, via Forest Lookouts)
Both structures burned in a 2000 forest fire (firelookout.com; Forest Lookouts). A Missoulian subhead says ground crews could not safely work the site; article body unread, date unverified

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com dates the site to 1930 with a log cabin and platform tower; both sources date the 30-foot L-4 tower to 1934, so the 1934 tower is the structure described here

notes_for_editor: Build date (1934) and fire (2000) agree across sources; the 1930 cabin date comes only from firelookout.com. The Missoulian article body is not readable in our cache, so only its headline and subhead are quoted; its date and fire details are not verified beyond those. The 1939 Ravalli Republican item is cited only as quoted on the Forest Lookouts page. No access or present-day site information was found, so the record's access 'unknown' stands. Photos credited to Fire Lookout Museum and Gary Weber on firelookout.com were not added because no licence is stated. The record's status, kind, design, agency and coordinates match the sources; no corrections proposed.
